guided_practice.title: Predict then observe
guided_practice.prompt: Make records for 4 packs of 6, then 5 packs of 6. Predict before running. Record actual output, any error and what changed. If working on paper, label both results as traces.
guided_practice.answer: Expected 24 then 30. Accept actual errors with an accurate account; do not replace observations. Record the changed pack count, saved file and run or trace status. Two matching cases do not show all inputs are handled.

independent_case.title: Changed independent case
independent_case.task: Set total=0, then for values2,4,9 perform total=total+value. Trace the result. What changes if total=0 moves inside the loop before that addition?
independent_case.answer: Running totals are2,6,15. Resetting inside the loop produces2,4,9, leaving9. Initialization location changes the written procedure; neither version trains a model.

blocks.title: A calculation from paper to output
blocks.caption: Assign per_pack before the multiplication. This diagram summarises the steps; the complete script below includes that assignment.

blocks.title: Python 3 code
blocks.text:
packs = 4
per_pack = 6
total = packs * per_pack
print(total)

Read the script from top to bottom. The equals sign assigns the value on its right to the name on its left. The star means multiplication. print(total) displays the value of total; it does not display the letters in the name. Type ordinary straight characters and keep the parentheses. The Python prompt symbols >>> are not part of this saved script.
